subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Participar de troca de opiniões e informações sobre textos, lidos na sala de aula ou em outros ambientes.

components.description_pt: Expressar uma opinião sobre um texto lido dentro ou fora da sala de aula em inglês
components.description_en: Express an opinion about a text read in or outside the classroom in English
components.cc_component_description: State a clear point of view or opinion on a topic or text in an opinion piece

components.description_pt: Responder às opiniões de pares sobre textos durante trocas de discussão em aula
components.description_en: Respond to peers' opinions about texts during classroom discussion exchanges
components.cc_component_description: Respond to others' comments with remarks that contribute to the discussion

components.description_pt: Compartilhar informações relevantes sobre um texto lido em contexto comunicativo apropriado
components.description_en: Share relevant information about a text read in an appropriate communicative context
components.cc_component_description: Recount key ideas from a text read aloud using relevant details

cc_matches.description: Pose and respond to specific questions by making comments that contribute to the discussion and elaborate on the remarks of others.
Recount or describe key ideas or details from a text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media.
Write opinion pieces on topics or texts, supporting a point of view with reasons.
